title: GamepadMappingLayout
description: Which index space a GamepadMapping's button and axis indices live in. Almost every mapping is written against the W3C "standard" layout the browser normalises known devices into. A `Raw` mapping instead encodes a device's unnormalised HID report order, which is only correct while the browser leaves that device unnormalised.

sections.title: Import
paragraphs: Which index space a GamepadMapping's button and axis indices live in.

Almost every mapping is written against the W3C "standard" layout the browser normalises known devices into. A `Raw` mapping instead encodes a device's unnormalised HID report order, which is only correct while the browser leaves that device unnormalised.
